skills.name: Goodnight!
skills.description: Summons Puck and attacks with strong ice magic. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

skills.name: Lesser Spirit Talk
skills.description: Communes with lesser spirits. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec) *HP x 60% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Re:ZERO
abilities.description: Re:ZERO Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
